description: MITRE D3FEND defenses that counter a MITRE ATT&CK technique. A technique id such as T1055 also matches its sub-techniques. Source: MITRE D3FEND (MIT license).

attack_technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique id in upper case, e.g. T1055 or T1055.012

name: d3fend_for_attack

attack_techniques.description: Each technique id that matched, once, in id order. A technique id also matches its sub-techniques. [] when no D3FEND defense counters the id. defenses is then [] too.

attack_label.description: The ATT&CK name of the id. null when the catalog gives none.

subtechnique_of.description: The parent technique of a sub-technique, such as T1055. null for a technique.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

defense_count_by_defense_tactic.description: Defenses per D3FEND tactic. Each of the seven tactics has a key, also with a count of 0.

attack_technique_ids.description: The matched ids this defense counters, in id order.

defense_tactic.description: One of the seven keys of defense_count_by_defense_tactic.

digital_artifact.description: A D3FEND digital artifact of the defense. null when the catalog gives none.

parent_defense_labels.description: Parents in the D3FEND tree, the nearest first. [] for a top-level defense.

uri.description: The defense's IRI in the D3FEND ontology.

title: D3FEND Defenses for ATT&CK
